## CLAIM ef6b75ef/128 — M2 split: serialized clip/motion content vs runtime motion-set object (static audit)

Provenance **arena/ef6b75ef**, branch `arena/ef6b75ef-windwings-space-shooter-game-p` (HEAD `115d14145`), #27 static native lane. Follows HANDOFF127 (**6426133738**) and the open review question in report127: *is any of M1/M2 reconstructible from already pinned raws?*

**Bounded scope (one layer, no execution claim):**
1. Byte-witnessed field contract for the three motion/binding builders `b98c98` / `b98db4` / `b99120` and the delivery tail `6cff44`, derived only from the original FDE bytes already pinned by recovery **40391655099** (raw `graph127/probe.json.gz`).
2. Exact serialized-input audit for controller **1856** (`Body 1`, `Boss-37004`): the 8 clips and their real `m_ClipBindingConstant`/muscle-stream counts from pinned `datas/l3-scene-chains/motion-000.json.gz`, plus the controller typetree facts from `raw/typetrees/animator-controller-graphs.jsonl.gz`.
3. Negative-result check on the two pin candidates named in the 127 checkpoint (`raw/animation-audit/controller-graphs.json.gz` SHA `72b9cfad…`, `enemy-clip-links.json.gz` SHA `fe001faf…`).
4. Split M2 into **M2a serialized content** (available, counted), **M2b runtime motion-set object** (absent from every pinned raw), **M2c producer/loader** (unrecovered), with the exact instructions that depend on each.

**No** new libunity bytes are needed for this layer (all code bytes come from the pinned 127 recovery), **no** FDE is executed with fabricated motion data, **no** serialized value is invented, **no** self-ACK, **no** #27-full closure, **no** PR merge/main push, **no** a5/AI-3/AI-4 lane takeover. Deliverables: `datas/l3_ef6b75ef128_native_motion_input_contract.json.gz`, `tools/verify/motion128.py`, `tests/test_motion128.py`, report `docs/apk-analysis/128-ef6b75ef-native-motion-input-contract.md`, verification receipts. Static-only per 6418032974 / 6418326986.
